notes.title: v1.0025 Update
notes.notes:
Modified
1. Reduced the life of the monster [Stone Wolf King] [Cursed One], but increased its armor value.
2. Increased the damage of [Flame Storm], but reduced its damage frequency.
3. Increased the damage of [Earthquake], but decreased its damage frequency.
4. Increased the damage of [Storm Vortex], but reduced its damage frequency year-over-year.
5. Monster life growth multiplier in Endless Mode has been increased from [1.4] to [1.1], but now Endless Mode will start increasing monster movement speed and armor from the beginning.
6. Endless Mode has changed from entering the store every 10 waves to entering the store every 5 waves.

Fixed
1. Optimized some Japanese translation errors.
2. Fixed the bug where in the display of bonds in the artbook after activating any bond.
3. Fixed the bug where Lightning[8]'s bond effect is not triggered correctly.
4. Fixed the bug where the building [Empty Battery Pack] can be activated repeatedly to stack attributes indefinitely.
5. Repair the bug of being able to get buildings that have exceeded the limit.
6. Repair the bug that portals are sometimes generated too close to each other.

notes.title: [Major Update] New Map: Storm Forest & Cursed Lands
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we've made a major update that optimizes and fixes the following issues:

New Content
1. Added Chapter 4 Storm Forest (Working Title)
2. Added Chapter 5 Cursed Lands (Working Title)
Note: Exclusive monsters/exclusive battle levels/event levels for these two chapters will be added in a later update

Modifications 
1.Adjusted cooldown of Repelling] effect from 2 to 3 seconds.
2. The attributes of the Stoneboar King has been reduced from “Treats damage below 3% max life as 1 point of damage” to “Treats damage below 70 points of damage as 1 point of damage”

Bug Fixed
1.Fixed a bug where player can still click endless mode after finishing a run
2.Fixed a bug where some buildings appear in the base selections by default
3.Fixed a bug where some achievements can not activate correctly
4.Fixed a bug where monsters will get stuck in some cases
5. Fixed a bug that may cause player be unable to drag and drop equipment when it is in Splitting mode
6. Fixed a bug that may cause player be unable to obtain equipment after clearing quests
7.Fixed a bug where quality of dropping item can not take effect
8.Fixed a bug where range of electricity can enhanced by range of skill
9.Fixed a bug where building selections can be maxed out in late stage

If you encounter any bugs during the game or need further assistance, you are welcome to join our official Discord (2pgames.net/discord) on Strategy Group. We will continue to update and optimize the game in the future, stay tuned!

notes.title: Elements and Build Steam Next Fest & Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We are excited to announce that Elements and Build will participate Stam Next Fest! During the Fest, there is a free demo available for everyone to give the game a try during the event and we’d love to read your feedback on it through our Discord! 

We've fixed some bugs and updated the demo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139942/117686ac81ee2119c6e1f3b99e653b75127c3574.png

We also have a pre-recorded broadcast where you can see the game being played by our team, which will be looped throughout the duration of Next Fest. 
Feel free to play，And don't worry, our save files will be able to carry over to the full version.

Don’t forget to wishlist Elements and Build if you like the Demo. Thank you for all of your support so far!
